summary: Short kerb by the oval, right at a busy junction with shops opposite.

best_section.where: West kerb beside the oval, just before the junction at the shops

drivers.seclusion: Oval and trees on the near side. Apartments 19 m and a shop 13-17 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on this kerb, so there is a lane to pull into; only about 21 m of line, close to a junction.
drivers.traffic: Junction with turning traffic and signals right here.
drivers.convention: A few cars parked along the kerb, so a van would not stand out much.

flags: Too close to the junction to stop legally is possible
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the kerb from the west and south-west; open sky to the east.
cannot_judge: Signs and no-stopping zones near the junction
